The largest data centers in the Netherlands are in the Eemshaven. You keep the power they rely on running.
As an Electrical Engineer Data Center you work on the critical electrical installations in the Eemshaven: UPS systems, standby generators, distribution boards and the measurement and control equipment that goes with them. You carry out preventive maintenance, inspect installations, take measurements, resolve faults and record every action, because in these buildings the documentation weighs as much as the work. You are there when the manufacturer commissions new systems, so you see up close how a site is built up. If you come from commercial and industrial buildings and UPS is new to you, you learn those systems here on the installation itself. The work asks for precision and reliability: in these buildings the power must never fail.
The essentials: Salary €3.300 to €4.100 per month · 38 hours per week · Fulltime · Based in Groningen.
In this role you earn €3.300 at entry, rising to €4.100 as an experienced engineer. Growing on to Senior can later reach €4.900, but you are applying now for the Data Center Engineer role.
What you bring
- MBO 3 or 4 Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience
- Solid experience as an electrical engineer in commercial and industrial buildings, for example offices, healthcare, industry or data centers
- Knowledge of UPS systems, distribution boards, backup power and instrumentation, extensive experience with them is a strong plus
- NEN 3140 VP and VCA, or the willingness to obtain them
- Driver's license B; Dutch and English at working level

What we offer
- Work in the largest and most secure data centers in the Netherlands
- Training and certification on UPS systems from Eaton and Schneider Electric
- NEN 3140, VCA, LOTO and ESD training
- The opportunity to obtain NEN 3840 (high voltage)
- Metal & Engineering CAO with travel allowance, overtime pay and ADV days
- A clear growth path to Senior Data Center Engineer

The Analytical Center of Excellence (ACE) organization is looking for a 
Junior Analytical Technician 
(full shift) in the Chemicals lab located in Terneuzen, The Netherlands.

Servings multiple production plants such as polyurethanes and polyglycols results in the need for a 24/7 service and a full-shift roster to perform the analysis of all plant samples.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Ensure service requests are accurately run, and the data returned as per sample plan. 

• Analytical equipment operations and troubleshooting as per procedures. 

• Provide input of quality data into LIMS, document and communicate results. 

• Perform calibration and first line-maintenance of analytical equipment. Document/administrate these maintenance activities. Communicate maintenance work when required. 

• Apply Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S), Analytical Work Process and Operating Discipline/Quality System procedures and practices as well as cGMP/pharma standards. 

• Participating in and completing of laboratory training and corporate required trainings. 

• Co-operate and communicate with co-workers and clients to maintain workflow and instrumental information, and to share and leverage problem solving and prevention expertise. 

• Contribute to value creation by continuous improvement of procedures in the analytical work processes and related tools and performance metrics. 

• Promote a well-organized, responsive, efficient workplace and work well both as a team member and independently. 

Qualifications
 
 

• MBO-4 laboratory degree or similar (bachelors degree preferred). 

• Fluent in Dutch and English. 

• Experience in an industrial laboratory (analytical) 

• Able to work in full shift (24/7 roster): morning, afternoon and night shifts.  

 
 

Preferred qualifications
 
 

• GMP/pharma experience. 

• Experience in operation, calibration, maintenance and troubleshooting of analytical equipment. 

• Knowledge of quality data systems like LIMS, OpenLab, etc. 

• Good lab techniques, methodical record keeping, and the ability to work both independently and with co-workers. 

• Excellent human relations, organizational and communication skills are necessary to communicate with team members, partners and outside customers. 

• Exhibit confidence in confirming validity of methods and data. 

• Able to handle multiple tasks and work under pressure.
